author: B7264DDjamess

title: Great food and wine
text:
My wife and I had a wonderful time at this wine and food pairing experience. We were lucky enough to be the only guests that day, which made it feel very private and romantic.

Our host, who is originally from Chicago, was friendly, welcoming, and made the experience even more enjoyable. The wine was delicious, the food pairings were excellent, and we learned a lot along the way.

If you’re looking for a relaxing and intimate experience in Barcelona, I highly recommend this tasting!
author: Erika_G

title: Everything except finding...
text:
Everything except finding it was excellent!
Host was awesome, food fantastic-Ira a full meal, wine matched well with the food.  I highly recommend.  Despite the different languages being spoken everyone friends and shared many stories.
author: Kim_K

title: Don’t miss this opportunity
text: In primate dinner with wonderfully paired dishes and local wines. The company around the table was eclectic yet engaging even amidst language differences. Will recommend to several friends visiting the area.
author: Kati_F

title: Barcelona Wine Tasting
text: We lost power during our wine tasting and the staff was absolutely wonderful and entertaining during this power outage.  Definitely recommend going on this excursion to anyone looking to book.  Wine and food was excellent.
author: Teleis_S

title: Excellent experience!!!
text: I had an absolutely wonderful experience at Vivinos in Barcelona! The wines were exceptional, and the food was simply delicious. During dinner, I had the chance to meet some truly remarkable people, which made the evening even more special. A huge highlight for me was our sommelier, Rezi – their knowledge, passion, and recommendations made the experience unforgettable. I can’t wait to come back!
author: lizat425

title: Excellent wine and food
text: It's a very intimate setting with about 8 other people. The wine and food were amazing! The staff was very nice and did a great job of explaining each wine and each pairing of food. If you're a foodie this is a wonderful place.
author: Jessica_S

title: Great evening with friends
text: A delicious meal, great wine, and new friends- what else could you ask for? The location was a little tricky to find, but the experience was worth it!
author: Renee_B

title: A Fantastic Wine and Tapas Experience – Highly Recommend
text:
This wine-pairing tapas dinner was absolutely fantastic. The food and wine were both delicious, and each pairing felt thoughtful and perfectly matched. Robert did an outstanding job accommodating dietary requests and took the time to explain every wine and why it complemented each course, which added so much to the experience.
The setting at Vivino was lovely and intimate, creating the perfect atmosphere for a relaxed, memorable evening. We all had a wonderful time, and the great music was a nice extra touch. I would highly recommend this experience to anyone looking for a special, well-curate
author: Kris_M

title: Delightful experience!...
